summary: the case machine.installer-repair.resume on i686, the updates stopped part way and resumed, through tests/run installer-repair on the test stick and disk staged with the tree's utils/rach2-install

argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 utils krffs ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/images/cases/recovery.iso build/images/cases/recovery.krffs build/images/cases/recovery-keyless.krffs build/images/cases/install-stick.img build/images/rach2-recovery*.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery*.iso build/images/installer-test.disk build/images/install-test-stick.img build/images/installer-root.ext2 && make -s -j8 build/images/install-test-stick.img build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f ${WORK}/rach2-install && build/krffs/readfile.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs /bin/rach2-install ${WORK}/rach2-install
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run installer-repair 'run: installer-repair: PASS'

faults.name: keys
faults.summary: write_archive does not archive the machine's Dropbear keys, so the update loses them

edits.find:
if [ -d "$1/etc/dropbear" ]; then
        cp -R "$1/etc/dropbear" "$next_archive/etc/dropbear" ||
            die "the host keys could not be archived"
    fi
    if ssh_host_keys "$1"; then
        { mkdir -p "$next_archive/etc/ssh" && cp "$1"/etc/ssh/ssh_host_* "$next_archive/etc/ssh/"; } ||
            die "OpenSSH's host keys could not be archived"
    fi
    archive_account_keys "$1" || die "the account keys could not be archived"

faults.name: archive
faults.summary: the update rebuilds the archive slot it was chosen from, which leaves no complete copy when it stops

faults.name: case
faults.summary: two key names that differ only in case are not refused, so FAT32 folds them into one file

edits.find: die "ssh key names collide on FAT32: $entry and $other"

faults.name: retry
faults.summary: an update run again in the same boot ignores the copy the first kept before it wrote the root
